articles.summary: CEDAR PARK, Texas, June 4, 2018 /PRNewswire/ — Firefly Aerospace, Inc. (Firefly), a developer of orbital launch vehicles for the small to medium satellite market, announced today the execution of a Launch Services Agreement (LSA) with Surrey Satellite Technology Limited (SSTL) for use of the Firefly Alpha launch vehicle. “Firefly is pleased to enter into...
articles.title: Surrey Satellite Technology Limited Awards Launch Services Agreement to Firefly Aerospace
